title: GNN-VIEW: Visual Inspection and Explanation of Graph-based Earth-System Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.35693v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine learning Earth-system models are becoming increasingly important, and so is their development. Graph-based models, one of the most prominent approaches, allow developers to constrain the learning process before training via graph connectivity. Yet, developing these models remains challenging: the graph is built algorithmically with little intuition about the final result beyond static plotting, which requires extra work and is often not detailed enough. Even after successful training, how the model arrives at forecasts remains obscure. We present GNN-VIEW, an interactive browser-based tool that supports the development of such systems. GNN-VIEW exposes the graph's information pathways, allowing model developers to debug the graph structure before training. translated_title: GNN-VIEW：基于图的地球系统模型的可视化检查与解释
translated_abstract: 机器学习地球系统模型正变得越来越重要，其开发过程也是如此。基于图的模型是最突出的方法之一，它允许开发人员在训练之前通过图连接性来约束学习过程。然而，开发这些模型仍然具有挑战性：图是通过算法构建的，除了静态绘图之外，对最终结果缺乏直观认识，这需要额外的工作且往往不够详细。即使训练成功，模型如何得出预测结果仍然不透明。我们提出了GNN-VIEW，这是一个支持此类系统开发的交互式浏览器工具。GNN-VIEW展示了图的信息路径，使模型开发人员能够在训练之前调试图结构。训练完成后，GNN-VIEW使用基于归因的可解释性方法来揭示训练后的模型在给定预测中使用了哪些输入特征。这有助于开发人员理解...
tldr: GNN-VIEW是一个交互式浏览器工具，可在训练前可视化并调试基于图的地球系统模型的图结构，并在训练后通过基于归因的可解释性方法揭示模型预测所依赖的输入特征。
en_tdlr: GNN-VIEW is an interactive browser-based tool that enables developers to visually debug graph structures before training and uses attribution-based explainability to reveal which input features drive a trained graph-based Earth-system model's forecasts.
